properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Gaussian 16, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1
properties.note: First-order saddle, exactly one imaginary frequency -398.72 cm-1 (17 real modes). Measured mode composition (from the frequency log): dominant displacement on the methylene hydrogens (H7 50%, H8 11%, H6 15%; heavy-atom fraction 9.8%), pair projections C3-H6 0.526 vs B1-H6 0.050 - i.e. CH2-H wagging/rehybridisation (C3 sp2->sp3) dominates with a smaller C3...H6 component; the B1-H6 bond is barely stretched at this early saddle. Geometry B1-H6 1.24, C3-H6 2.14, B1-O2 1.77, O2-C3 1.23 A. Reproduced independently at -141.015601412 Ha (qc_ts2/ts_opt2.log, exact-Hessian Opt=TS).

properties.method: B3LYP-D3(BJ)/def2-SVP, Gaussian 16, gas phase, charge 0, multiplicity 1
properties.note: Methoxyborane H2B-O-CH3 (B-O 1.34, O-C 1.42 A). Opt+Freq, normal termination, 0 imaginary frequencies; two B-H (2528/2637 cm-1) and three C-H (3020/3113/3120 cm-1) stretches. Decisive test of the compact/bridged region: unconstrained Opt+Freq from the bridged frame (B1-H6 1.479, C3-H6 1.494, B1-O2 1.467 A) collapses directly to this product (qc_ts2/bridged_unconstrained_optfreq.log, E = -141.113508746 Ha, 0 imaginary), so that region is inside the product basin and is not an intermediate.
